note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. The only contest was in Hilltown; the other divisions were uncontested and are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (Newry Reporter, 9 June 1955, p. 5). Carrickcrossan, Glen, Mayo and Rathfriland North and South had no nomination; their retiring members are named in column 7 of the notice as deemed re-elected (page image read, round2-down 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
